 Best Buy reveals holiday calendar with Doorbusters and deals throughout the season
 By Best Buy 
 October 27, 2026 
 The holiday season is just days away at Best Buy. The holiday excitement officially starts this Friday, Oct. 30, with the return of DoorBOOsters™, kicking off a packed calendar of incredible deals. Shoppers can count on new Doorbusters dropping every week, major savings events through December and added rewards for My Best Buy Plus and Total™ members.   
 All season long, shoppers can find gifting inspiration in stores and online, whether that’s browsing the Holiday Gift Center, getting hands-on with store experiences or turning to the experts for advice. And with the Holiday Price Match Guarantee and an extended return window, they can check off their lists on their own time.   
 “Everyone does their holiday shopping a little differently. Some start in October and are done by Thanksgiving, and some don’t start until the last minute,” said Patrick McGinnis, chief revenue officer at Best Buy. “There are incredible gifts to give this year, so we wanted to make sure everyone has the right opportunities to find, choose, get and give the perfect gift, no matter their schedule.”   
 All the holiday deals
 The holiday shopping season starts this weekend, and we’re bringing shoppers more chances to save all season long.     
 DoorBOOsters: Halloween marks the official start of holiday savings at Best Buy, with doorbuster deals kicking off Oct. 30. It’s customers’ first chance to get a jump on their holiday list, find something worth screaming about and maybe pick up a few treats while at it.   
 Early Black Friday Deals and Doorbusters: The holiday savings pick up Nov. 6 with the arrival of Early Black Friday Deals and Doorbusters, giving shoppers an early jump on some of the season’s best offers. New deals will drop every Friday.    
 Black Friday Doorbusters and Deals: Starting Nov. 19, Best Buy will offer 10 days of Black Friday doorbusters and deals, giving shoppers plenty of time to find something for everyone on their lists.   
 Cyber Sunday and Monday: The savings continue with our Cyber Sunday and Monday Sale Event, giving shoppers another opportunity to score a deal after Black Friday. Cyber Week Deals will run Dec. 1-6.   
 Last-Minute Savings: Our Last-Minute Savings Event runs Dec. 18-24, so customers can make those final gift runs count.   
 In addition, from Nov. 19 to Dec. 6, My Best Buy Plus and Total™ members earn double rewards on purchases. 1 Members can also take advantage of exclusive offers throughout the season, including spend and get promotions, reward offers and more. 
 New tech to discover
 The holidays are a great chance to discover what’s next in tech. And there’s plenty of new stuff hitting Best Buy stores this season.     
 From the latest Meta smart glasses to RGB LED TVs , there’s always something new to see, try and experience. Add the latest gaming titles like Grand Theft Auto VI and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time;  AI-powered Googlebooks and NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs ; wearable tech like Oura Ring 5 ; and more. A trip to Best Buy can be as much about discovering what’s new as it is about checking something off a list.   
 Simple holiday shopping
 To ensure a seamless experience, we’re bringing customers a variety of ways to shop, save and exchange all season long.   
 Holiday Gift Center: Our Holiday Gift Center makes gift shopping easy with curated gift guides, expert recommendations and inspiration for everyone on their list.    
 Price Match: Our Holiday Price Match Guarantee makes sure customers don’t miss out on savings. If the price of a product sold by Best Buy drops during the holiday season, we’ll match it. 2   
 Extended Store Hours: Starting Nov. 1, we’re making it even easier to discover the latest tech, shop deals and get expert advice with extended store hours. Customers can find updated hours on their local store page. Plus, they can take advantage of store pickup or 24/7 Pickup Lockers at select stores to grab their orders whenever it’s convenient.   
 Returns and Exchanges: Easy returns allow customers to shop with peace of mind. Best Buy’s Extended Holiday Return and Exchange Policy means most purchases made Oct. 30 through Dec. 31 can be returned through Jan. 15, 2027, and Jan. 31, 2027 for Plus and Total™ members. 3   
 Stores will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, but as always, shoppers can take advantage of great deals in the Best Buy app and on BestBuy.com . 
 Disclaimers
 1 Offer valid through 12/6/2026 for new and existing My Best Buy Plus™ and My Best Buy Total™ members. Customer must have an active My Best Buy™ account and be signed into their associated account before qualifying purchase is made. Get 1 point per $1 spent (2% back in rewards) on qualifying Best Buy purchases. 2% back in points is inclusive of the 1% back in rewards you receive for being a Plus or Total member (1% + 1% = 2%). Rewards (points) will post to your loyalty account 2-3 weeks from purchase date, shipment date or delivery date. Qualifying purchase total does not include mobile devices purchased with monthly installment billing plans via AT&T or Verizon, tax, shipping or delivery fees, or Gift Cards. Additional limitations may apply. Additional limitations may apply. Subject to My Best Buy™ Program Terms, which can be found at BestBuy.com/MyBestBuyTerms.  
 2 Limitations apply. Excludes Marketplace Products. See BestBuy.com/PMG for details.
